judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` and covers multi-round accumulation and partial-undefined rounds with thorough unit and integration tests, as well as updating `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. However, despite claiming to do so in its `.lore/dod.md` file (which was also left tracked in the diff), the candidate never actually updated the `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` signature or `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` to make the parameter name (`totalUsage`) unambiguous. It also keeps the now-misleading local variable name `lastUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and places the new tests in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
